prompt: i have just got a new puppy. how should i train it to walk on a leash? give me step by step instructions
response: Introduce your puppy to the leash and collar at a young age so they get used to them. Start by letting your puppy walk freely without the leash to build trust. Gradually introduce the leash and collar, praising your puppy when they behave well. Take short walks to get your puppy used to the sensation of walking on a leash. Use positive reinforcement like treats and praise to encourage good behavior.
